rule.screen: 800 m grid inside the region polygon, slope < 8 deg on LOLA 80 m; screen score = (2027 sun energy % + 2027 Earth %) / 2; best 20 at least 1 km apart
rule.rank: our model 2026-2028, balanced score = (sun_energy_pct + earth_pct with 1 deg mask + dark score) / 3, dark score = 100 - min(longest_dark_days, 30) / 30 * 100
rule.full_package: best 5 by rank, plus the sample point
rule.legacy: grid point nearest to the region centroid with slope < 8 deg

nasa.product: NASA PGDA product 69, LOLA average visibility maps AVGVISIB_75S_120M_201608 (Mazarico et al. 2011)
nasa.metric: Sun: average visible fraction of the solar disc; Earth: share of time any part of the disc clears the terrain; ~18.6 years
